mainEntity.name: What is the process for cabinet repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cabinet repair process typically begins with an initial consultation and assessment of the damage. We then provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we schedule the repair work at your convenience. Our skilled technicians meticulously address the damage, ensuring a high-quality finish and structural integrity. We aim to complete repairs efficiently and with minimal disruption to your home.
